about_short_description.short_description: Svix is the webhooks-as-a-service platform that empowers companies of all sizes to send webhooks easily and reliably.

product.name: Svix Core
product.description: An API-driven webhook sending platform that manages webhook delivery, retries, security, and scalability for developers.

product.name: Svix Ingest
product.description: A webhook receiving gateway that securely receives, verifies, processes, and routes incoming webhooks with scalability and low latency.

product.name: Svix Application Portal
product.description: A standalone or embeddable user interface for managing webhook endpoints, viewing logs, and inspecting webhook delivery reports.

product.name: Svix Play
product.description: A free web-based webhook tester and debugger for inspecting, testing, and debugging incoming webhooks from any service.

product.name: Polling Endpoints
product.description: An alternative webhook delivery method allowing users to poll a URL to retrieve webhook events in real-time or batches instead of receiving push notifications.

product.name: AI-Generated Transformation Templates
product.description: A feature that uses AI to generate JavaScript code for transforming webhook payloads to formats required by external services.
